description: Dataset of long-term performance monitoring for road traffic marking materials in Beijing exposure test site from 2022 to 2025 2022-2025年北京道路交通标线材料暴露观测场长期性能观测数据集 is a data set deposited in ScienceDB (Science Data Bank) by its authors Jiao Chengwu, Sun Ming (Research Institute of Highway). This dataset consists of observational data from 15 types of road pavement marking materials deployed at the Beijing exposure test site for road marking materials, compiled into a single file with four worksheets. For each road pavement marking material, measurements were collected from two sets of markings - horizontal and longitudinal pavement markings. Coverage: Beijing exposure test site. The formats are not stated in the metadata. Size stated: 96285 bytes. It is reached through its DOI or landing page, listed on this page. Access is free of charge and open according to the repository. The licence is not stated (no licence in the DataCite metadata read on 2026-09-29). Caveats: written from the DataCite metadata (title, abstract, subjects and rights) read on 2026-09-29; the deposit itself was not opened or downloaded, so its contents, quality and current availability were not checked, and the coverage and resolution are those of the abstract only. It can support transport-network, traffic and mobility studies. Related record: the repository-level record data-sciencedb-repository.
